What is a good name for a pet tortoise?
7:23 AM

Shelly is my pick: short, sweet and a little obvious, which suits a tortoise. Other good ones: Turbo (a joke about the speed), Pebble, Gandalf (wise and very old-looking) or Mr. Slowpoke. Tortoises can live 50 years or more, so choose a name you'll still enjoy then. 🐢
